correctness.rationale: Let B=im D^T and Z=ker D. A vertex stabilizer fixes only zero cycle flow: all edges among other parts change sign under swap, and remaining two orbits of flows are forced zero by divergences at the distinguished vertex and an external vertex (p>=2). Hence Hom_Gamma(B,Z)=Hom_Gamma(Z,B)=0, so averaging any projection onto either invariant subspace yields its Euclidean projector and cannot increase any ℓq norm. Exact transfer-current Q=D^T(DD^T)^+D has two-part potentials U=(rp−1)/(r(r−1)p²), V=1/((r−1)p²)−1/(rp²). Summing six edge-type multiplicities yields sharp endpoint cut constant 2+2/r−4(rp−1)/(r(r−1)p²), cycle constant 3+2/r−8(rp−1)/(r(r−1)p²); real symmetry gives ℓ∞. Direct rational graph Laplacian and projection-column checks for (r,p)=(3,2),(3,4),(4,3),(6,2) agree. Finite checks do not establish all (r,p,q), which follow from the averaging proof. Finite difference sign yields transitions at p=5,6,7.
